# [P1] ProductDetails: Clicking product image on inventory navigates to product details page

Step 1: Observe that each product on the inventory page has a clickable image
  Expected: Product images on the inventory page are rendered as clickable links with pointer cursor

Step 2: Click the product image for 'Sauce Labs Bike Light'
  Expected: Click on the 'Sauce Labs Bike Light' image triggers navigation

Step 3: Observe navigation occurs to the product details page
  Expected: URL changes to /inventory-item.html

Step 4: Observe the product details page content matches the clicked product
  Expected: Product details page displays 'Sauce Labs Bike Light' name, description, and '$9.99' price
